BiblicalUsage: Eliphelehu is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 15:18, the text says "and Elipheleh."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliphelehu matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
